expected_total_detail: Unified NBA Structural v7 totals engine. KenPom matchup pace, B2B drag (-0.8 poss), 3-in-4 schedule fatigue (-0.6 pts), close-game OT risk (+1.2 pts), and 15% replacement-aware injury shrinkage.
expected_total_formula: est_possessions * (off_away + off_home) / 100 with OT adjustment (+1.2 pts if abs(margin) <= 3.5)
note: Overhauled NBA total points model v7. Validated on 650 holdout games and 88 live 2026-27 games (Total MAE 15.16).

qualification.note: Point-in-time walk-forward validated on 650 games from locked holdout.
